corrections.issue: Slight misreading of the number: Jim said hedge fund positioning (size) has doubled in four to five years, while gross leverage in long/short equity is typically about 3x; he did not say gross leverage doubled.
corrections.fix: Structured-product inflows plus low summer volume compress implied and realised volatility at the index level; hedge fund positioning (assets/exposure) has doubled in four to five years with long/short equity gross leverage near 3x.

completeness_estimate: 0.78 - the first reader captured nearly all of the main arguments and forecasts; it missed some supporting data (index returns, equity flatness since 2021, copper move), data-integrity mechanisms and the PTJ allocation debate details.
